decks.name: Hamlet
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set slings-and-arrows. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Hamlet
hero.specialAbility:
THE QUESTION
At the start of your turn, choose TO BE or NOT TO BE. If you choose NOT TO BE, deal 2 damage to one of your fighters.
TO BE: When you maneuver, draw 1 additional card.
NOT TO BE: Add +2 to the value of Hamlet's attacks.

cards.title: Blood Will Have Blood
cards.afterText: If Hamlet took damage this turn, deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Maddening Insight
cards.duringText: The value of this card is equal to the number of cards in your hand.
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, your opponent discards 1 card.

cards.title: Method in the Madness
cards.basicText:
Put any number of cards in your hand on the bottom of your deck. Then, draw up to that many cards.
Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Nothing Either Good or Bad
cards.afterText: If your opponent played a versatile card, deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Outrageous Fortune
cards.duringText: Discard the top card of your deck. Add its BOOST value to this card's value.
cards.afterText: If you lost the combat, return the card you discarded to your hand.

cards.title: The Ghost
cards.basicText:
Choose one:
• Hamlet recovers 2 health
• place Hamlet in any space in his zone and gain 1 action

cards.title: The Play's the Thing
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards 1 random card. If you won the combat, Hamlet recovers health equal to its BOOST value.

cards.title: The Readiness Is All
cards.afterText: Place one of the fighters in the combat in any space. They cannot leave that space this turn.

cards.title: The Rest Is Silence
cards.afterText: End the turn.

cards.title: To Sleep, Perchance to Dream
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, move the opposing fighter a number of spaces up to the amount of combat damage dealt. If you lost the combat, Hamlet recovers 1 health.

cards.title: Uncertain Doom
cards.duringText: If your opponent played a versatile card, ignore its value.

decks.name: Shakespeare
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set slings-and-arrows. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Shakespeare
hero.specialAbility:
IAMBIC PENTAMETER
After you attack or defend, add your card to your line.
When your line has 10 or more syllables, discard your line. If there are exactly 10 syllables, resolve the completion effect on the last card.

cards.title: Again
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 2
🪶 COMPLETION: Draw 1 card.
cards.afterText: You may return the first card in your line to your hand (before you add this to your line).

cards.title: Alas
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 2
🪶 COMPLETION: Draw 2 cards. Shakespeare recovers 2 health.
cards.afterText: If you lost the combat, Shakespeare recovers 1 health.

cards.title: All Are Punished
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 4
🪶 COMPLETION: Draw 1 card.
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each other fighter in your zone.

cards.title: Deceive
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 2
🪶 COMPLETION: Return this card to your hand.
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Et Tu, Brute?
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 4
🪶 COMPLETION: Place each of your fighters in any space.
cards.duringText: Increase the value of this card by +1 for each of your fighters adjacent to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Horror
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 2
🪶 COMPLETION: Deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter for each other card in your line.
cards.duringText: Increase the value of this card by +1 for each HORROR card in your line.

cards.title: My Kingdom for a Horse
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 6
🪶 COMPLETION: Gain 2 actions.

cards.title: Once More unto the Breach
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 6
🪶 COMPLETION: Return all defeated Actors to spaces in Shakespeare's zone.
cards.afterText: Return a defeated Actor to any space in Shakespeare's zone.

cards.title: Places, Places!
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 4
🪶 COMPLETION: Place Shakespeare in a zone with no Actors.
cards.afterText: Move each Actor up to 3 spaces.

cards.title: Revise
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 2
🪶 COMPLETION: Move each fighter up to 2 spaces. (This includes opposing fighters.)
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. If you won the combat, draw 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Such Sweet Sorrow
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 4
🪶 COMPLETION: Draw 1 card.
cards.afterText: Move your fighter up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: The Ides of March
cards.basicText:
SYLLABLES: 4
🪶 COMPLETION: Deal 2 damage to any opposing fighter.

ruleCards.title: Your line
ruleCards.content: Keep the attack and defense cards you play in a row beside your deck (your line) instead of discarding them. Each card shows its syllables (the number and dots on its left edge). Reaching 10 or more: discard the whole line; exactly 10: first resolve the 🪶 completion effect of the card that completed it.

decks.name: Titania
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set slings-and-arrows. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Titania
hero.specialAbility:
FAIRY MAGIC
If you do not have a face-up glamour at the start of your turn, flip the top card of your glamour deck face-up.
Its effect is ongoing while it remains face-up.

cards.title: As Wise as Beautiful
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. You may discard your glamour to draw 2 cards instead.

cards.title: A Momentary Glance
cards.basicText: Deal 2 damage to any fighter in Titania's zone.

cards.title: But a Dream
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card, ignore its value, and return it to your opponent's hand.
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Fairy Song
cards.duringText: You may discard your glamour. If you do, the value of this card is 5 instead.

cards.title: Gift of the Fair Folk
cards.basicText:
Choose 2 different effects:
• one fighter recovers 2 health
• draw 2 cards
• move two fighters up to 2 spaces each

cards.title: Met by Moonlight
cards.afterText: Place Oberon in a space adjacent to Titania.

cards.title: Parting Gift
cards.afterText: You may deal 2 damage to each fighter in the combat.

cards.title: Protection of the Fairy Woods
cards.immediateText: You may discard your glamour. If you do, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Queen of the Fairies
cards.duringText: Increase the value of this card by +1 for each glamour in your glamour discard pile.

cards.title: The Moon Looks Down
cards.afterText: Put a discarded glamour on the bottom of your glamour deck.

cards.title: What Fools These Mortals Be
cards.basicText: Choose an opponent, look at their hand, and choose a card. They shuffle that card into their deck.

cards.title: Whisked Away
cards.afterText: Move your fighter up to 2 spaces. You may discard your glamour. If you do, place your fighter in any space.

ruleCards.title: Glamour deck
ruleCards.content: Shuffle the 6 glamours face down beside your deck. "Discard your glamour" puts the face-up one in your glamour discard pile; "a discarded glamour" comes from there.

ruleCards.title: Glamour of Greed
ruleCards.content: At the end of your turn, you may draw 1 card.

ruleCards.title: Glamour of Jealousy
ruleCards.content: When Titania or Oberon are attacked, before playing a card, they may swap spaces. If they do, your other fighter is now the defender.

ruleCards.title: Glamour of Love
ruleCards.content: When you maneuver, you may move an opposing fighter 1 space before moving your fighters.

ruleCards.title: Glamour of Sleep
ruleCards.content: Your fighters do not take damage other than combat damage.

ruleCards.title: Glamour of Invisibility
ruleCards.content: Your fighters may move through opposing fighters.

ruleCards.title: Glamour of Rhyme
ruleCards.content: After you play a scheme, gain 1 action.

decks.name: The Wayward Sisters
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set slings-and-arrows. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: The Wayward Sisters
hero.specialAbility:
BUBBLING BREW
Your cards go into your cauldron instead of your discard pile.
After you attack, you may cast one spell that you have the ingredients for. If you do, discard all the cards in your cauldron.

cards.title: All-Seeing Familiar
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Lizard’s leg
cards.immediateText: Return a card in your discard pile to your cauldron.
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, look at the top card of your deck and put it in your hand or cauldron.

cards.title: Curious Familiar
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Bat
cards.afterText: Return a card in your cauldron to your hand.

cards.title: Double, Double
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Lizard’s leg
cards.duringText: Increase the value of this card by +1 for each different ingredient symbol in your cauldron.

cards.title: Fire Burn and Cauldron Bubble
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Bat
cards.immediateText: Return a card in your discard pile to your cauldron.

cards.title: Hurly-Burly
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Snake
cards.duringText:
Reveal the top card of your deck. Your opponent chooses one:
• put that card in your hand
• put that card in your cauldron and add its BOOST value to this card's value

cards.title: Pricking of My Thumbs
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Snake
cards.afterText: Deal damage to the opposing fighter equal to the amount of combat damage your fighter took.

cards.title: Prophecy
cards.basicText:
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put 2 of them in your hand and the other 2 back on top of your deck in any order.
INGREDIENT: Lizard’s leg

cards.title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
cards.basicText:
Cast any spell. Then, cast a different spell. (Do not discard any cards from your cauldron to cast these spells.)
INGREDIENT: Bat

cards.title: The Stars Align
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Lizard’s leg
cards.duringText: The value of this card is equal to the number of different zones all of your fighters are in.

cards.title: Toil and Trouble
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Snake
cards.duringText: Increase the value of this card by +1 for each different ingredient symbol in your cauldron.

cards.title: Unnatural Remedy
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Snake
cards.immediateText: Discard up to 3 cards from your cauldron. For each one, choose a fighter to recover 1 health. (You may choose the same fighter more than once.)

cards.title: Ward
cards.basicText: INGREDIENT: Bat
cards.afterText: Place the opposing fighter in any space in your fighter's zone.

ruleCards.title: Spells (cauldron)
ruleCards.content:
Each card shows one ingredient: Snake (green), Bat (purple) or Lizard’s leg (red). Cast a spell with the ingredients in your cauldron:
• Snake + Bat: Draw 1 card. One of your fighters recovers 1 health.
• Snake + Lizard’s leg: Move any fighter up to 3 spaces.
• Lizard’s leg + Bat: Deal 1 damage to a fighter that shares a zone with any of your fighters.
• Snake + Lizard’s leg + Bat: Gain 1 action.

ruleCards.title: Cauldron
ruleCards.content: Put your played and discarded cards on the cauldron (beside your deck) instead of your discard pile; when you cast a spell, move them all to your discard pile.

ruleCards.title: Three sisters
ruleCards.content: The Wayward Sisters are three heroes of 6 health each, each with her own health dial; a defeated Sister leaves the board and you lose only when the last one falls. An effect on "your hero" affects the Sister you choose. Here: the hero is one Sister and the other two are the "Wayward Sister" sidekicks, each with her own 6-health counter.
